image_description: A low-angle, close-up shot of a large radio telescope structure against a blue sky. The image features a massive, segmented parabolic dish antenna tilted upwards. The back of the dish reveals a complex truss support structure made of metal beams. Below the main dish, there are secondary reflector elements or feed horn assemblies mounted on articulated arms. The base of the structure sits on a dry, grassy field with distant hills visible in the background.
